Use Tier 2 architectural deepening: add causal attention over earlier GRU states to the existing GRURec. Focus on model_design and training_evaluation. The sampled-softmax attempt reduced macro validation HR@10 from 0.5737 to 0.5613, so another loss-only change has limited support. A plausible representation bottleneck is that the current predictor compresses the entire history into its final recurrent state, potentially losing older interests relevant to the next item.

At each sequence position, use the current GRU state as a learned attention query over the GRU states at that position and earlier positions. Mask padding and future positions, then fuse the resulting context with the current state through a learned elementwise gate before the existing projection and normalization. Keep the tied item embeddings, learned item bias, score scale, and single scoring head; train the attention and gate jointly with the GRU. This supplies content-dependent access to earlier interests while remaining one independently trained network per category.

For this controlled experiment, retain the supplied best GRU code’s independent positive/negative softplus objective, eight uniform negatives, optimizer, window sampling, and training settings. Preserve the supplied splits, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], all four categories, and trial-local artifacts. Update checkpoint metadata and the predictor writer to reconstruct the augmented architecture and load exactly one newly trained checkpoint per category, with identical sequence processing during validation and host inference. Select checkpoints using fixed validation HR@10 with the existing NDCG tie-break, assess improvement using the pinned host macro HR@10, and report category regressions without accessing hidden test files or generating a separate test submission.
